items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: Old Man Weyer himself directed the band, and one of the greatest violinists in America, Paul Weyer, is a product of that band.

ctx.x: How big is the band? You never mentioned how big it is.

Oh, nothing under 30 pieces. Nothing under 30 pieces at no time. Mr. Jenkins kept it up at that strength for years. In the winter in Florida, when they take the tour down in Florida for the winter season, then it would drill down to say about 20, some odd, maybe 24. Because the bigger boys in the band, the larger and more older boys, they kept them in school. Because he would always stress an education. So the boys who were members of the band, ranging in age from 12 to 16, he put them in the classroom so they…
South Carolina, and that's the band I came up in. How young were the youngest ones in there usually?
